title: Substituted / unusual pyrovalerones
disclaimer: Game catalog. Not a cookbook. No recipes, precursors, doses, or route SOP. Scores are unitless 0-100 inferences. Unknown is null, never 0. Pleasure and compulsiveness are independent.

comparison_notes.a-PVP: Flakka ceiling. Social then sirens. Compulsiveness near family top. Not scored here.
comparison_notes.MDPV: 2010 bath-salt monster. Often the actual powder in NRG-1 bags stamped naphyrone.
comparison_notes.a-PHP: Later body-heavy vape favorite. 4F-PHP is its fluoro stamp.

substances.name: Pyrovalerone

feel.headline: The medicine they pulled because people liked it too much — then flakka showed what too much meant.

rush.note: DAT/NET blocker; milder than a-PVP in leftover recreational reports.

euphoria.note: Functional stim, not a roll. Weak SERT.

enjoyment.note: Polite ancestor. People liked it enough to lose the prescription.

compulsiveness.note: Withdrawn for abuse. Not bath-salt TV.

reinforcement.note: Meltzer/Simmler DAT/NET potent, not a releaser.

substances.npc_line: The medicine they pulled because people liked it too much.
gaps: Recreational chorus thinner than a-PVP; most evidence is medicine-era plus in-vitro.

substances.name: 4-MePPP

feel.headline: Not the rush. The German stamp they put on a packet when they ran out of carbons.

rush.note: Short-chain 4-Me. Street consensus: not the rush.

compulsiveness.note: Still DAT-selective; no CPP in rats; lower abuse signal than a-PPP class.

psychosis_concern.note: STRIDA detected; not a headline toxin.

substances.npc_line: Not the rush.
gaps: Name collision with opioid MPPP (desmethylprodine). Flag hard.

substances.name: MPBP

feel.headline: The forgotten stair between not-the-rush and Centroton.

rush.note: SAR between 4-MePPP and pyrovalerone. Almost no modern reports.

reinforcement.note: German designer-drug era metabolism papers, not behavioral.

substances.npc_line: The forgotten stair.

sources.title: Westphal / Springer / Maurer MPBP metabolism era papers

gaps: Feel is series-inference. Do not invent trip reports.

substances.name: MPHP

feel.headline: Cocaine's understudy that put a man in rhabdo. The long German one.

rush.note: Used as a cocaine stand-in in the Sauer case.

euphoria.note: DAT/NET in pyrovalerone class, not 4-MePPP class.

enjoyment.note: Serious tox, not a beloved RC.

reinforcement.note: Niello: grouped with pyrovalerone, not the weak short 4-Me.

substances.npc_line: Cocaine's understudy that put a man in rhabdo.
gaps: Enjoyment inferred; most literature is tox not pleasure.

substances.name: MOPPP

feel.headline: They put a methoxy on the short one and the rush left the room.

rush.note: Weakest transporter hit in Niello series (micromolar DAT/NET).

euphoria.note: Lowest DAT/SERT ratio of that set — still not a roll.

compulsiveness.note: Looks like a pyro, hits like a shrug.

substances.npc_line: They put a methoxy on the short one and the rush left the room.
gaps: Detected in mixes; almost no dedicated user text.

substances.name: 4F-a-PVP

feel.headline: Flakka's fluoro twin. Some liked it more. Nobody liked the morning.

rush.note: Forum: coke-shaped even insufflated; vape rumor ROA.

euphoria.note: Split: some call it happier/level vs a-PVP sirens.

enjoyment.note: Better night than a-PHP for some. Still a pyro morning.

compulsiveness.note: Ridiculous redose urge even when mood is good. Independent of enjoyment.

reinforcement.note: STRIDA most-seen substituted pyro; DAT-blocker class.

paranoia.note: Less cartoon-psychosis than deep a-PVP binges in several writeups; still a pyro.

substances.npc_line: Flakka's fluoro twin. Some liked it more. Nobody liked the morning.
gaps: Enjoyment split should not be averaged into timid compulsiveness.

feel.headline: Same demon, thicker stamp. The one that doesn't write back.

substances.npc_line: Same demon, thicker stamp.

substances.name: 4-Me-a-PiHP

feel.headline: Half a nanomolar at DAT. Sweden counted the bags. Enjoyment filed a missing-person report.

rush.note: First isomer 2020; most tox detections.

euphoria.note: No pleasure chorus; infer mid stim.

enjoyment.note: Five autopsies in one country. Not a beloved night.

reinforcement.note: Nastiest DAT number on this shelf.

psychosis_concern.note: 37 tox cases / 5 autopsies in Sweden set.

substances.npc_line: Half a nanomolar at DAT. Enjoyment filed a missing-person report.
gaps: Literature so far Sweden-only. Under-reporting possible.

substances.npc_line: The one they poured when 4-Me got heat.

substances.name: Naphyrone

feel.headline: The name on the packet. Not the powder. If it was real, it was the pyro that remembered serotonin.

rush.note: Scores are for the molecule (b-naphthyl). Street NRG-1 is usually something else.

euphoria.note: Only SNDRI pyro in Meltzer set. Simmler: cocaine-balanced DAT/NET/SERT.

enjoyment.note: Theory: more pleasure than MDPV. Practice: you probably got MDPV.

compulsiveness.note: Lower fiend than DAT-only monsters IF real. Independent of the brand's MDPV compulsiveness.

paranoia.note: Genuine-molecule reports thin; NRG-1 reviews are MDPV-shaped.

psychosis_concern.note: ACMD treated it as a real stim risk.

substances.npc_line: The name on the packet. Not the powder.

sources.title: Brandt 2010 UK NRG-1 test purchases (1/13 real)

gaps: Street reviews of NRG-1 are not naphyrone reviews. Treat as mislabel rolls.
